title: Why Blind Faith Stalls Your Spiritual Ascent (1984-08-02)
description:
Frustrated by the confusion of modern religions and spiritual markets? Discover the verifiable, living experience of your own spiritual ascent.

This public program explores the living process of human ascent, moving beyond blind faith and organized religion to actual spiritual experience. Shri Mataji answers seekers' questions and culminates the session with a practical, guided meditation to experience the Kundalini awakening firsthand.

Key Topics:
• 🌿 Beyond blind faith: Why true spirituality must be a verifiable, living experience actually felt on your central nervous system
• 🔬 The knowledge of the roots: Understanding how spontaneous awakening heals the physical body and changes your daily priorities naturally
• 💭 Breaking free from conditioning: Discover the profound difference between intellectual understanding and actual evolutionary transformation
• 💬 Q&A insights: Breaking down misconceptions about gurus, reading books for realization, and the true meaning of devotion (Bhakti)
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience: A practical session to awaken your Kundalini and feel the cool breeze of the Spirit on your own palms

“It is not what you profess is important, but what you become. Becoming is the point. What you become on your central nervous system.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Is it possible to awaken Kundalini without a spring guidance like You because You are not available to us so only by reading books?
• So how could we have Divine guidance like You?
• At what time would you suggest to come to get Self Realization?
• Why do Christians and Catholicism particularly make such a thing of the Pope? He's only flesh and blood.?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to feel your chakras on your central nervous system?
• What is the difference between blind faith and true spirituality?
• How does spiritual awakening cure physical and mental illnesses?

Have you ever felt frustrated by mental concepts of God? Share how it felt when you finally experienced the cool breeze of your own Spirit.
